name: Pipe to Shell Execution (Curl / Wget to Bash)
description: Detects curl or wget piped directly into a shell interpreter (bash, sh, zsh) on Linux/macOS.
explanation: Direct pipe-to-shell patterns bypass disk inspection and execute unverified remote code in memory.
investigation_steps: Inspect the remote URL queried by curl/wget.
Review process ancestry and parent user.
Check persistence folders for newly registered startup scripts.
